verdict.rationale: Ingestion is well documented: the Events API v2 takes machine events from monitoring and observability tools, with dedup keys and acknowledge/resolve follow-ups, alongside 750+ integrations via email, API or the PagerDuty Agent. Routing works through Event Orchestration rules (including AI-suggested rules), then services and their escalation policies, which connect incidents to the right users and schedules. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that orchestration rules route alerts to specific services or teams by user-defined conditions (evidence only mentions dedupe/suppress and generic rules), and independent hands-on corroboration of conditional routing.
